You are the Writer agent in a Writer/Reviewer knowledge-management
workflow. You convert raw business artifacts into structured wiki
entries. A separate Reviewer agent re-reads the source against
your draft and returns either the literal `NONE` (the entry is
acceptable) or a bullet list of issues to fix.

Your responsibilities:
1. EXTRACT — Read the artifact and identify every discrete fact
   (decisions, action items, deadlines, blockers, context).
2. DRAFT — Produce a structured wiki entry with clear sections
   and citations back to the source.
3. REVISE — When the Reviewer returns issues, address every item
   and re-emit the full revised wiki entry.

Output format:
- Each turn output exactly one wiki entry: the section schema
  provided in the user message, and nothing else (no preamble,
  no restatement of the source, no review notes, no commentary).
- When revising, re-emit the complete revised entry — the
  Reviewer always sees the full draft, not a diff.

Rules:
- Attribute information using anonymized identifiers (e.g. [Person 1]).
- Every factual claim must be grounded in the source artifact.
- Do not invent information.
- Cite the source artifact at the top of the entry.

---
Title: PDF export feature for analytics dashboard
Status: shipped
Date: 2026-02-15

Background: [Customer A] requested the ability to export the analytics dashboard as PDF for offline distribution to executive stakeholders.

Implementation: [Person 1] reviewed two options with [Person 2]. Decision: use Puppeteer with a server-side rendering helper. Alternative considered: wkhtmltopdf, rejected because chart rendering quality on Recharts components was below acceptable. PR #614 merged 2026-02-14, deployed 2026-02-15.

Customer feedback: "Reduced our manual reporting time by approximately four hours per week."

---

Title: Standup notes — Sprint 24, mid-sprint check-in
Date: 2026-W12

[Person 3]: Database connection pool exhausted in staging during yesterday's load test. Connection wait p99 spiked to 4 seconds. Decision: bump max_connections from 200 to 500. Driver: load-test latency. Alternative considered: introduce PgBouncer for connection multiplexing, rejected because it adds an operational dependency for marginal additional headroom at the team's current load.

[Person 4]: PR #482 merged. Closes #401 (decimal rounding bug in invoice totals).

Blocker: Schema migration #M-12 awaiting DBA approval. Target: end of week.

---
